title: Mārketinga nodaļa no deviņām automatizācijām: kā izveidot savu
seoTitle: Mārketinga nodaļa ar Claude un n8n | Mārketinga Skola
description: Kā deviņas automatizācijas un viens cilvēks katru dienu publicē ierakstus ar Notion, n8n, Zernio un Claude, un kur šāda sistēma lūzt.
facts: The source is Rihards Zeila's own English guide (rihardszeila.com/blog/marketing-department-on-claude-and-n8n), written from systems he runs himself. Take its content, numbers and steps; write the Latvian fresh, not sentence by sentence.
Never name the print-on-demand store, and never say or hint at what it sells, its theme or its niche: it is only 'a print-on-demand ecommerce project'.
